dedupe_keys.name: izvadak iz registra certificiranih instalatera sustava obnovljivih izvora energije

description: Izvadak iz Registra certificiranih instalatera sustava obnovljivih izvora energije is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministarstvo graditeljstva i prostornoga uređenja (NEAKTIVAN). The extract from the Register contains data on persons authorised by the Ministry of Construction and Physical Planning for installers of renewable energy systems. Coverage: Ministarstvo graditeljstva i prostornoga uređenja (NEAKTIVAN). The portal shows the English title as "Extract from the Register of Certified Installers of Renewable Energy Systems" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministarstvo graditeljstva i prostornoga uređenja (NEAKTIVAN). Its keywords include obnovljivi izvori energije, registar, certifikati. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
